name: Drupal Canvas Field Component
description: Places rendered entity-field output as a component inside Drupal Canvas templates, using the field's normal formatter pipeline.
project_description: Canvas Field Component adds a single 'Field display' Canvas ComponentSource plugin (id: field_display) that lets a Canvas ContentTemplate place the rendered output of any entity field into the layout, without that field first needing a mapping to a Canvas/SDC component property. When dropped into a template the component reads the ContentTemplate's target entity type, bundle and view mode, presents a select of the bundle's fields, lets the author pick a field formatter (plus its settings, label display and third-party settings), and renders that field for the previewed/live entity through Drupal's normal field formatter pipeline. This means image styles, responsive images, date/text formats, entity-reference rendering and multi-value output all work, and formatter-extending modules such as Smart Date and Date Augmenter are supported via third-party settings. It behaves like Layout Builder's field blocks but for the Canvas page builder. Per the maintainer, the initial build was AI-assisted (Claude and Codex). Requires the Drupal Canvas module, Drupal core ^11.2 || ^12, and PHP 8.3.
